usual_baseline: Early CT is good: 88–98.3% [2324][2537]. Water-soluble contrast is patchy: 12% [2324], 37% [2378], 64% [2147], 80% [2069]. Delays to surgery are long: 4 days [2378], 2.4 days [2537]. Operative mortality 14% [2393][2537].
fix_that_works: Flowchart plus a theatre slot within 72 hours: SBO operative mortality 14% to 5% [2393]. Presenting NASBO recommendations at governance: water-soluble contrast 12% to 44%, no oral intake >5 days 44% to 17% [2324].
fix_that_fails: Nutritional assessment did not improve after governance presentation: malnourished identified 6% then 5% [2324].
consultant_advice: CT timing is already good and not worth auditing. Measure water-soluble contrast use, time to theatre after failed conservative care, and nutrition. Guaranteed theatre access is the fix with an outcome to show for it.
